The '''Prowler 1000 seeker droid''', also known as the '''Prowler 1000 exploration droid''', '''Arakyd seeker droid''', and retroactively dubbed the '''"Probot 1.0,"''' was a compact [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] manufactured by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] and deployed during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] by the [[Clone trooper/Legends|soldiers]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. The first entry in the [[Arakyd Probot Series]], it would be improved and refined into the [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droid]].

==Characteristics==
Created by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]], the small, [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsor]]-driven seeker [[Droid/Legends|droid]] excelled in surveillance. Designed specifically for work in a military capacity, the Arakyd Prowler 1000 featured a frontal [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptor]] array equipped with various detection systems and scanners. A tasking antennae protruded from atop the drone's domed head, allowing [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone commanders]] to send orders directly to their seeker groups. Two grappling extensors below the main body were used to return a body to the clones when proof was needed of a successful capture. Seekers were equipped with searchlights to track targets at night or in darkened environments.<ref name="NEGD" />

==History==
[[File:Prowler1000-NEGTD.png|thumb|left|250px|A Prowler 1000 [[Probe droid/Legends|seeker droid]]]]
After [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] issued [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] dispatched his entire complement of seeker droids into the depths of [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau's]] sinkhole city to hunt down and destroy [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. Searchlights activated in the grotto's deep below [[Pau City/Legends|Pau City]], two particular seekers diligently hunted [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] Kenobi, but rather than locating the wayward [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], the drones happened upon an agitated [[Nos monster/Legends|nos monster]]. Protecting its young, the nos monster devoured one seeker with a single bite, and chased the second drone into the murky waters of its domain. Obi-Wan was able to slip away from the short fight between monster and machine, and eventually fled the sinkhole world.

Arakyd Prowler 1000 droids witnessed the reconstruction of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] in the [[Emperor Palpatine Surgical Reconstruction Center|Imperial rehabilitation center]]. Seeker droids were employed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to hunt down Jedi during the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. Years later, based on the success of its predecessor, Arakyd Industries introduced the [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droid]].

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a Prowler droid was deployed at a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] transport terminal to ask about the whereabouts of a [[Unidentified Rebel spy|Rebel spy]]. However, the StarSpeeder carrying the spy took off, pushing the Prowler droid into deep space.<ref name="Star Tours: The Adventures Continue">Note that the droid only appears in one of the two randomly chosen opening scenes of ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''.</ref>

At the start of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], [[Prowl]] was a Prowler 1000 exploration droid used by [[Finn Galfridian]].<ref name="Star Wars: Invasion">''[[Star Wars: Invasion]]''</ref> After the rise of the [[One Sith]] and the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|reborn Galactic Empire]] a century after the end of the war, the Prowler 1000 was still in use, with the droid being employed by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] such as [[Rav]] by [[137 ABY]].<ref name="leg3">[[Legacy (2006) 3|''Legacy'' (2006) 3]]</ref>
